info.description: Staging regression requests and tests preserved from the repository collection. Set base_url to the staging origin. Set staging_email and staging_password locally to enable authenticated requests. Run the complete collection in its saved order.

variable.description: Base URL of the Bunkai staging API (e.g. https://staging.bunkai.io)
